merge_rcq_itq: merge a ResidualCoarseQuantizer and ITQ encoder into a single Faiss IndexIVFSpectralHash index
read_file_zip: read numpy arrays and JSON data from specific keys inside a zip file using BenchmarkIO
write_file_zip: write numpy arrays and JSON data to named keys inside a zip file using BenchmarkIO
read_write_index: read and write Faiss index files including pickle-based RCQ-ITQ merged indexes using BenchmarkIO
launch_jobs: launch local or SLURM-distributed jobs via submitit AutoExecutor using BenchmarkIO with a callable and param list
